description: Estimate a full-truckload freight rate for a lane using FreightFA's DAT-basis rate engine. Returns a directional benchmark for planning. Each call counts as one estimate toward the account's monthly FreightFA allowance.

distance.description: Lane distance in miles. recommend_mode returns it for a city or ZIP pair.

origin.description: Origin city and state; provide with destination, or use both ZIPs.

pickup_date.description: Pickup date YYYY-MM-DD; omitted uses the calculator default.

request_id.description: request_id from recommend_mode for this lane, or null. Links the price to that search.

weight.description: Shipment weight in pounds, or null.

name: estimate_truckload_rate
title: Estimate truckload (FTL) rate
